title: Example showcase: solar system
description:
Flashy high-detail free-fly solar system from the Sun through Neptune — Earth's Moon, Saturn's rings, an asteroid belt, and a dense starfield.

**Keyboard free-flight.** Click the canvas to capture the pointer, then fly with **WASD** thrust, **Space** / **Ctrl** (or **E** / **Q**) climb and sink, **mouse** look, and **Shift** boost. **C** snaps the camera near Earth. Host **R** and **/** stay reserved.

Orbits and spins use the host sim clock (**Play/Pause** freezes them). Flight stays live while paused. From the cards, tune orbit time scale, eccentricity, fly feel, sun and corona, star and asteroid density, mesh quality, and which bodies are shown.

Distances are compressed for flyability (not true AU scale).

attribution.author: igoakulov
attribution.prompt: With the Scenie skill, make a flashy high-detail solar system where I can fly with keyboard. Go all out.
